line: Hello! I will be your assigned cause of death today. Please hold still!
Oh, a visitor! I will try to make this quick. For you, anyway!
Target acquired! Processing your complimentary destruction now. This will only hurt a lot!
You look like you need shooting. Lucky me — that is exactly what I do!
Initiating lethal contact! Thank you for choosing DeathBot as your end-of-life provider!
Initiating aerial bombardment! Have a wonderful afternoon!
Oh, you looked up! Perfect timing. Firing now!
Hello from above! I have located you and will now shoot you repeatedly. Please hold still!
Altitude confirmed. Target confirmed. Fun confirmed. Commencing fire!
Surprise! I found you from up here! Now I will shoot you a whole bunch. How exciting!
Oh! I appear to be destroyed. Have a wonderful day!
Shutting down! Please rate your destruction experience five stars!
Oops! Total system failure! Anyway — great meeting you!
Huh. Exploding. That's new. Thanks for the feedback!
Critical damage detected! Fun fact: this is fatal. No follow-up appointment needed. Bye!
